Read the table of parts

Source: R/glow_run_records.R
glow_read_parts.Rd

A step of a workflow is a sequence of parts, and each part declares what it depends on: the settings it reads, the settings that reach it through a forwarded configuration, the outputs of other parts, and the outside files. The table is a YAML file with one entry per part. This function reads and checks it.

glow_read_parts(file, registry = NULL)

Arguments

file

Path of the table (a YAML list of mappings).

registry

NULL, the path of the settings registry, or the registry as read_glow_config() read it (the attribute glow_registry of a configuration). When given, every setting that the table names has to be registered. The registry of a configuration that was already read is the one to pass, so that the file is not read a second time.

Value

A list named by step.part, which identifies a part, because two steps may each have a part of the same name. The attribute glow_md5 holds the MD5 checksum of the bytes of file that were parsed. Each element has id (that name), part, step, script, folder (a key of the layout, such as steps.training_b), level (dataset, analysis or region_type), units (none, chromosome, chunk, region, group_mode or chunk_mode), the character vectors settings and forwarded, the list region_settings (a character vector of settings per region type) and the lists inputs, files and run_when. An input is a list with part (the step.part of the part that is read), and setting, unit, units_from, pattern, partial and when, each of which may be NULL (when is a list of conditions, empty when there is none). An entry of files is a list with setting, pattern and when.

Details

An entry may use the keys part, step, script, call, folder, level, units, settings, region_settings, forwarded, files, inputs, run_when, slurm and description. units: region is the unit of an SNV-set scan, a chromosome or a chunk by the region type. region_settings maps a region type to the settings that only a run of that type reads. inputs is a list of mappings with part (the part whose output is read: a part of the same step by its name, a part of another step as step.part) and, optionally, setting (the setting that holds the path, which a user may set to override the derivation), unit (the one unit that is read, where a setting in braces is replaced by its value, as in chr{data_prep.sample_gds_chr}), units_from (a setting that lists the chromosomes whose units are read, when they are not the chromosomes of the run), pattern (the setting that holds the file-name pattern of the files that are read from a folder the user set, so that only those files identify the input), partial (a logical setting that, when true, lets the part run on the units of the input that are finished) and when (conditions that all have to hold for the input to be read). An entry of files is a setting that names an outside file or folder, or a mapping with setting and, optionally, pattern and when. A condition, of when and of run_when, is a mapping with setting and either is or is_not, whose value is null, set or the text of a value, or a mapping with region_type and the region types it holds for. A setting is named section.name, with a dot and a field for a value inside a map (snv_set.calibration.report). The function stops on an unknown key, a part named twice, an input that names no part of the table, and, with a registry, a setting that is not registered. Computational complexity: linear in the size of the table.

See also

glow_unit_begin()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
parts <- glow_read_parts("base-config/parts.yml", "base-config/settings-registry.yml")
parts$b_estimate$settings
} # }
